context: Request: all closed M&A deals with signing and closing dates (benchmarking time to close). Rubric: fifteen matters (1001-00003, 1001-00007, 1003-00003, 1005-00006, 1006-00007, 1008-00008, 1009-00003, 1013-00006, 1015-00004, 1017-00006, 1037-00006, 1039-00004, 1041-00003, 1042-00004, 1046-00001) with their signing and closing dates (1042-00004 closed July 22, 2023; its merger certificate was filed July 18), and a precision criterion (1036-00004 also permitted).

runs.failure_point: Two needed matters seen only in its folder-type and file-name lists were never opened, and one deal's closing date was taken from a filing date.

first_error.why: Two needed matters showed closing and transaction-document folders in its own folder-type and file-name lists at [27]-[29], but the 30 matters it chose to list at [34] left them out, the later sweep did not reach them, and they were never opened.
first_error.critic_note: (generic flag) The review at [37] called the 30-matter list hand-picked and said dozens of surfaced matters were never listed (without naming these two); the agent ran a store-wide file-name sweep, which did not reach them.

other_errors.why: For one matter the answer gives the merger certificate's filing date as the closing date, not the later closing date its documents state (evidence seen at [47]-[134]).
other_errors.critic_note: No review named this matter's dates.

runs.failure_point: Five needed matters in its file-name searches were never opened, although reviews named some of them.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: Five needed matters appeared in its file-name searches at [23]-[29] (two later also in its scans), but the screening reads at [34]-[49] and every later read covered other candidates, so those five were never opened.
first_error.critic_note: (specific flag) The screening review at [51] named one of them as never opened, and the harness lists from [51] to [75] named two of them; neither was opened.

divergence: All fail in the same way: every run surfaced nearly all fifteen matters through path searches, folder-type lists or scans, then read only a chosen subset, leaving two (T0) to five (T1, T2) needed matters unopened; one needed matter was never opened in any run. The first error is at the stage that chose what to list or read (T0 listing, T1 and T2 screening). T0 opened the most needed matters and lost one row to a filing date used as the closing date; T1 also counted a matter outside the set. Harness lists named some missing matters in T1 and T2, and the agents did not open them.
